english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a soft cushion used to support the head in bed.

examples.english: This pillow is too hard, and my neck hurts when I wake up.
examples.traditional: 呢個枕頭太硬，我瞓醒條頸好痛。
examples.jyutping: ni1 go3 zam2 tau4 taai3 ngaang6 ngo5 fan3 seng2 tiu4 geng2 hou2 tung3
